correctness.rationale: From actual Git RESULT.md blob 3770ffeb, the distance formulas are exact on H_n: same-side distinct vertices distance 2, opposite-side distance 1 for i<=j and 3 otherwise. For W with p A-landmarks and q B-landmarks, omitted A/B vertices have 2-multiplicities p/q respectively and side-specific cumulative 1-counts. There are at most q+1 and p+1 such counts, proving |W|>=n-1. At equality, prefix/suffix inequalities force x1=0, y_n=0 and x_{k+1}+y_k=1 for all k<n. This gives exactly the 2^(n-1) shifted-pair choices; omitted cross-side vertices collide iff p=q, the odd-n balanced case. Independent exhaustive direct distance-multiset checker for n=2,3,4,5 yielded basis counts 2,2,8,10, exactly the formula. These checks are finite corroboration; the prefix argument proves all n>=2.
